results.text: Real-world safety profile of bisoprolol: signal detection and demographic stratification using the FAERS database. Bisoprolol, a selective β₁-blocker, is widely prescribed for cardiovascular disease. Real-world pharmacovigilance can clarify adverse drug reactions (ADRs) across demographic strata and identify signals not fully characterized in trials.
